title: Haryana HTET 2025 Final Answer Key
postName: Haryana Teacher Eligibility Test (HTET) 2025 – Final Answer Key
vacancyDetails: Answer key related update for Haryana Teacher Eligibility Test (HTET) 2025 – Final Answer Key
selectionProcess: Written / CBT → Answer Key / Objections → Result
documentsRequired: Registration number / roll number; admit card for reference
howToApply:
1. Visit https://bseh.org.in
2. Open Answer Key / Response Sheet section
3. Download Haryana HTET 2025 Final Answer Key
4. Match answers with your response sheet
5. Raise objections within the official window if allowed
shortDescription: Haryana HTET 2025 Final Answer Key out. Download from bseh.org.in.
content:
Board of School Education Haryana (BSEH) has published the HTET 2025 Final Answer Key for Level-1, Level-2 and Level-3 as applicable.

The final key is used for evaluation after the provisional key and objection process. Download only from bseh.org.in.
